title: Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework for the sharing of influenza viruses and access to vaccines and other benefits: draft decision proposed by Secretariat with amendments by Member States

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: First page of Executive Board draft decision EB144/CONF./10 (2019) on the Pandemic Influenza Preparedness Framework, showing the Secretariat's text with bracketed amendments from the EU and USA, including requests on genetic sequence data and the Nagoya Protocol.

summary.text: Second page of the PIP Framework draft decision with tracked Member State amendments, covering assessment of a prototype search engine for products using influenza genetic sequence data, acknowledgement of data providers, and an amended footnote in Annex 2 of the Framework.
